   157	    def term_value(self, term: dict[str, Any], table: np.ndarray):
   158	        """Value of a term: a column vector, or a scalar for constants."""
   159	        if 'const' in term:
   160	            return int(term['const'])
   161	        if 'sum' in term:
   162	            total = None
   163	            for reference in term['sum']:
   164	                column = table[:, self.cell_index(reference)]
   165	                total = column if total is None else total + column
   166	            return 0 if total is None else total
   167	        column = table[:, self.cell_index(term['ref'])]
   168	        if 'scale' in term:
   169	            scale = int(term['scale'])
   170	            if scale != 1:
   171	                column = column * scale
   172	        return column

   174	    def evaluate(self, predicate: dict[str, Any], table: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
   175	        """Boolean vector of the predicate's value on every row of *table*."""
   176	        kind = predicate['kind']
   177	        if kind == 'cmp':
   178	            left = self.term_value(predicate['left'], table)
   179	            right = self.term_value(predicate['right'], table)
   180	            result = compare(predicate['op'], left, right)
   181	        elif kind in ('any', 'all'):
   182	            field = str(predicate['field'])
   183	            index = self.field_index[field]
   184	            op = predicate['op']
   185	            value = int(predicate['value'])
   186	            result = None
   187	            for slot in range(self.slots):
   188	                column = table[:, slot * self.field_count + index]
   189	                outcome = compare(op, column, value)
   190	                if result is None:
   191	                    result = outcome
   192	                elif kind == 'any':
   193	                    result = result | outcome
   194	                else:
   195	                    result = result & outcome
   196	        else:
   197	            raise ValueError(f'unsupported predicate kind: {kind!r}')
   198	        if not isinstance(result, np.ndarray):
   199	            result = np.full(table.shape[0], bool(result), dtype=np.bool_)
   200	        return np.asarray(result, dtype=np.bool_)

   212	    def discover(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   213	        """All eligible inclusion-minimal disjunctions with certificates.
   214	
   215	        A clause qualifies when it holds on every training window, loses that
   216	        property when any literal is dropped, and is falsified by at least one
   217	        window of the declared universe.  Clauses with the first property are
   218	        exactly the minimal members of the family whose literal-wise
   219	        falsification sets have an empty intersection, so a depth-first
   220	        enumeration of that family is exhaustive.
   221	        """
   222	        if not self._prepared:
   223	            self._predicate_masks()
   224	        count = self.predicate_count
   225	        width = self.width
   226	        # falsified-set bitsets over the training rows and over the universe
   227	        train_false = [self.train_full & ~mask for mask in self._train_true]
   228	        universe_false = [self.universe_full & ~mask for mask in self._universe_true]
   229	        found: list[tuple[tuple[int, ...], list[int], int]] = []
   230	        full = self.train_full
   231	
   232	        def emit(clause, prefixes, counter_mask):
   233	            size = len(clause)
   234	            suffixes = [full] * (size + 1)
   235	            for position in range(size - 1, -1, -1):
   236	                suffixes[position] = suffixes[position + 1] & train_false[clause[position]]
   237	            witnesses = []
   238	            for position in range(size):
   239	                # rows where every other literal is false; clause validity
   240	                # then forces this literal to be the only true one
   241	                others = prefixes[position] & suffixes[position + 1]
   242	                if others == 0:
   243	                    return
   244	                witnesses.append(lowest_bit(others))
   245	            if counter_mask == 0:
   246	                return  # no window of the declared universe falsifies it
   247	            found.append((clause, witnesses, lowest_bit(counter_mask)))
   248	
   249	        def walk(chosen, prefixes, and_value, universe_value):
   250	            start = chosen[-1] + 1 if chosen else 0
   251	            depth = len(chosen)
   252	            for literal in range(start, count):
   253	                value = and_value & train_false[literal]
   254	                clause = chosen + (literal,)
   255	                counter = universe_value & universe_false[literal]
   256	                if value == 0:
   257	                    # every training window satisfies the clause
   258	                    emit(clause, prefixes, counter)
   259	                    # any strict superset keeps that property, so dropping the
   260	                    # added literal can never be witnessed: do not extend
   261	                    continue
   262	                if depth + 1 < width:
   263	                    walk(clause, prefixes + [value], value, counter)
   264	
   265	        walk((), [full], full, self.universe_full)
   266	        found.sort(key=lambda item: (len(item[0]), item[0]))
   267	        return [
   268	            {'clause': list(clause), 'witnesses': witnesses, 'counterexample': counter}
   269	            for clause, witnesses, counter in found
   270	        ]
